title: 第10章  血月咒密辛，师尊之死
content_zh:
楚天雄将陆烬带到了他所修炼的地方，而这里即便对宗门长老来说，都属禁地。
陆烬虽意外，却也知道，自己之前所展现出来的实力，无疑引起了楚天雄的重视。
不过，楚天雄一开口，却说出了让他意外的话。
“你师尊果然没骗我。”
陆烬问道：
“宗主大人，您这话是何意？”
三年前，他与宗主并没有太多交集，甚至连自己师尊玄云子，跟宗主之间，也鲜有交往。
楚天雄淡淡一笑：
“陆烬，有些事情，想必你师尊也没告诉你，如今你蛰伏三年归来，果然如你师尊所说，必成气候，所以，本座今日，打算告诉你一些关于你师尊的事情。”
一听这话，陆烬眸色一变：
“我师尊？他老人家待我视如己出，可我却在他最需要的时候，丧失了一身修为，眼睁睁看着他离开而无能为力……”
想到这里，陆烬内心仍有针扎般的痛楚。
“没用的。”
楚天雄叹了口气说道：
“哪怕三年前本座亲自出手，也无力回天。”
楚天雄转过脸来，一双深邃眸子看着陆烬：
“因为，你师尊的死，另有隐情。”
陆烬皱眉：“还请宗主明示！”
楚天雄说道：
“确切的说，你师尊是死于，血月咒。”

“血月咒？”
陆烬眉头皱起，似乎并没听说过这种东西。
楚天雄缓缓道：“血月咒乃血月圣地老祖所施下的无解咒术！”
“一旦被下咒，便要永生听命于血月老祖。”
“而你师尊之所以暴毙，正是违逆了血月老祖之命，而被引发血月咒反噬而死。”
听到这话，陆烬更是难以置信：
“宗主大人，可否详细说说？”
楚天雄点头，道：
“此事说来话长，不过，如今你已有资格知晓此事。”
“我与你师尊玄云子，自小便在逍遥山村长大，可突然有一天，血月老祖出现在逍遥村，他生吃活人，将整个村子的所有活物屠戮殆尽！”
“而我与你师尊二人之所以活了下来，是因他从我们二人身上看到了超乎常人的修武天赋。”
“于是他将我二人带入血月圣地，种下血月咒，让我俩发誓誓死效忠于他。”
“可亲眼看着家人被他生吞活剥，我二人岂会甘心！”
“而这么多年来，因为血月咒的缘故，我们也只能服从于他，苟活下来，寻找机会报那血海深仇！”
“奈何！”
“这么多年过去，我二人虽修为大涨，可那血月老祖的实力却更加恐怖！”
“三年前你师尊以为有机可乘，能杀他，却最终失败，甚至因此丧命。”
“本座与玄云子情同手足！他死前，将自己的打算告知于我，当然，你身上究竟发生什么，本座也不清楚，但是既然你师尊说你三年后的今日，定会拥有一飞冲天的能耐，那本座便相信兄弟的话！”
“如今你身怀奇遇，本座也不多问，陆烬，今后修行需要任何资源，本座定竭力满足于你。”
“另外，这是你师尊托我留给你的东西，或许，这是查清你身世的唯一线索。”

楚天雄说着，将一块玉佩交到陆烬手中。
白玉无瑕，温润触感传来，他眉头微蹙。
一时间得知这些事情，心情复杂，但他还是拱手道：
“多谢宗主大人照拂！”
“弟子他日成就金丹，踏入紫府，必寻那血月老祖，为师报仇！”
可他这话说完，楚天雄却微笑摇头。
“紫府境，可还不够……”
陆烬哑然。
楚天雄手掌微微抬起，一团灵光凝聚掌心，那上面传出的波动，赫然超越了金丹之境！
“嗯？宗主，您的修为……”
楚天雄点头：
“本座早已踏入紫府境！可哪怕如此修为，也无法与血月老祖抗衡！”
他叹了口气，却忽然笑了：
“陆烬，本座并不怂恿你去复仇，可本座要提醒你，见到血月咒印记之人，一定要小心。”
说着，他掀开袖口，露出那月牙咒印。
“宗主……”
陆烬愕然。
“所有带着血月咒印记之人，都是血月老祖座下血使者。”
“而所谓血使者，则是为其寻找血食之人，也就是为其抓人助他修行的傀儡！”
“血月圣地盘踞青州，势力极大，血月老祖则是其最强掌舵人，其座下除了血使者外，还有月使者，这些人明面上是在维护整个青州，实则是维持百姓繁衍生息，如此才能为血月老祖提供源源不断的活人血食！”

“本座隐忍多年，其一是为逍遥村复仇，其二，则是要为苍生百姓拔掉这颗毒瘤！”
说完，楚天雄淡笑：
“今日之事，你知晓便可。”
“另外，那柳如烟与杨巅峰勾结，而杨巅峰的师尊赤羽长老，早已加入血使者联盟，所以，你务必要谨慎行事。”
“今日一战，你二人下了生死战书，姬邀月定会全力助柳如烟突破，你有何打算？”
陆烬想了想，说道：
“三年前，弟子闯过不少绝地，知晓一些修行秘境，我打算前去闭关修炼。”
楚天雄点点头，旋即将一枚纳戒送入陆烬手中：
“小小的青州，困不住你，陆烬，本座相信你。”
陆烬低头看着手中纳戒，没有拒绝，抱拳道：
“多谢宗主！”
楚天雄点头，然后看着陆烬离去。
“玄云子，你应该没看错人……”
陆烬离开之后，一路走出万剑宗山门。
而当他离开之后，身后数道人影相随而动，暗中跟踪，却正是那罗鹫以及数名长老。
“姬峰主交待，务必在生死战前，将他灭了！”
“罗长老，以我等的实力，如今已不是陆烬对手，当务之急，是寻求其他长老帮助！”
“呵呵，放心，姬峰主说了，一旦发现时机，立刻发传音符，自会有高手前去助阵！”
“跟上！”
而当陆烬从万剑宗出去之后，除了罗鹫等人外，还有另外一些身穿不同服饰的修士飞掠而来，降临到了陆烬身前。

“您们是？”
陆烬声音淡漠。
“这位兄弟，实不相瞒，我等已在此地等候多时！”
一位一袭黑袍约莫三十岁上下的男子拱手一礼，态度倒是颇为谦逊。
“等我？”
陆烬皱眉。
“不错！”
那男子倒也没有隐瞒：
“之前我等见识过兄台风采，想必兄台在这万剑宗内不太顺遂，以你的天赋，不如就加入我狂刀门，总好过在万剑宗受那鸟气！”
“哈哈，不错！我紫阳门也正有此意！”
“若是兄台愿意，本长老亲自保举你加入我紫阳门内门，享受宗派巨量修行资源！”
“……”
听着几人的话，陆烬这才明白，原来是想拉拢他。
“多谢诸位好意，在下要事在身，恕不奉陪。”
陆烬说着，直接转身。
“兄弟，狂刀门段天仇，后会有期！”
“紫阳门秦北，期待再见！”
二人说着，竟是将两枚纳戒抛向陆烬。
“无功不受禄——”
陆烬刚要婉拒，二人却笑道：

“兄弟不必客气，聊表心意而已，多个兄弟多条路，若是以后遇见，未免不可相互照拂，你说是不是？”
“雪中送炭总比锦上添花强，兄弟，我等是看上了你的潜力，并无他意，高兴就交个朋友，不高兴就各走天涯路！”
看他们爽快的态度，陆烬眉头微皱，旋即淡淡一笑，吐出俩字：
“陆烬。”
说完，他身形飞掠而出，眨眼百丈之外。
“陆烬？这个名字有点耳熟。”
“是他！曾经万剑宗内门第一弟子！”
“传闻他失踪三年，他竟没死？”
“非但没死，反而强势归来了！”
content_en:
Chu Tianxiong brought Lu Jin to the place where he practiced, which was a forbidden area even for the elders of the sect.
Although Lu Jin was surprised, he also knew that the strength he had shown before had undoubtedly attracted Chu Tianxiong's attention.
However, when Chu Tianxiong opened his mouth, he said something that surprised him.
"Your master really didn't lie to me."
Lu Jin asked:
"Lord Sect Master, what do you mean by this?"
Three years ago, he didn't have much interaction with the sect master. Even his master, Xuan Yunzi, rarely interacted with the sect master.
Chu Tianxiong smiled lightly:
"Lu Jin, there are some things that your master probably didn't tell you. Now that you have returned from hibernation for three years, as your master said, it will definitely come true. Therefore, I plan to tell you some things about your master today."
Upon hearing this, Lu Jin's eyes changed:
"My master? He treats me as his own son, but I lost my cultivation when he needed it most. I watched him leave and was helpless..."
Thinking of this, Lu Jin still felt pain like needles in his heart.
"It's useless."
Chu Tianxiong sighed and said:
"Even if I personally took action three years ago, I couldn't do anything to save it."
Chu Tianxiong turned around and looked at Lu Jin with his deep eyes:
"Because there is another hidden reason behind your master's death."
Lu Jin frowned: "Sect Master, please clarify!"
Chu Tianxiong said:
"To be precise, your master died from the Blood Moon Curse."
"Blood Moon Curse?"
Lu Jin frowned, as if he had never heard of such a thing.
Chu Tianxiong said slowly: "The Blood Moon Curse is an unsolvable curse cast by the ancestor of the Blood Moon Holy Land!"
"Once you are cursed, you will obey the orders of the Blood Moon Ancestor forever."
"And the reason why your master died suddenly was because he disobeyed the order of the Blood Moon Ancestor and was triggered by the Blood Moon Curse and died."
Hearing this, Lu Jin was even more unbelievable:
"Sir, lord, can you elaborate?"
Chu Tianxiong nodded and said:
"It's a long story, but now you are qualified to know about it."
"Your master, Xuan Yunzi, and I have grown up in Xiaoyao Mountain Village since we were children. But suddenly one day, the Blood Moon Ancestor appeared in Xiaoyao Village. He ate living people alive and slaughtered all the living creatures in the entire village!"
"The reason why your master and I survived is because he saw in us two extraordinary talents in martial arts."
"So he brought the two of us into the Blood Moon Holy Land, planted the Blood Moon Curse, and made us swear to be loyal to him to the death."
"But how can we be willing to watch our family members being eaten alive by him!"
"And for so many years, because of the Blood Moon Curse, we can only obey him, survive, and look for opportunities to avenge the bloody sea!"
"No way!"
"After so many years, although our cultivation levels have greatly increased, the strength of the Blood Moon Ancestor has become even more terrifying!"
"Three years ago, your master thought there was an opportunity to kill him, but he failed in the end and even died because of it."
"I and Xuan Yunzi are brothers! Before he died, he informed me of his plan. Of course, I don't know what happened to you, but since your master said that you will have soaring abilities three years from now, then I will believe what my brother says!"
"Now that you have an adventure, I won't ask any questions. Lu Jin, if you need any resources for your future practice, I will do my best to satisfy you."
"In addition, this is something your master asked me to leave for you. Perhaps, this is the only clue to find out your life experience."
Chu Tianxiong said and handed a jade pendant to Lu Jin's hand.
The white jade was flawless, and the warm touch came to him, and he frowned slightly.
After learning these things for a while, he felt complicated, but he still handed it over and said:
"Thank you, Master, for taking care of me!"
"This disciple will achieve the golden elixir in the future and step into the Zi Mansion. He will definitely seek out the Blood Moon Ancestor and avenge his master!"
But after he said this, Chu Tianxiong smiled and shook his head.
"Purple Mansion Realm, but it’s not enough…”
Lu Jin was speechless.
Chu Tianxiong raised his palm slightly, and a ball of spiritual light condensed in his palm. The fluctuations coming from it were astonishingly beyond the realm of golden elixir!
"Huh? Sect Master, your cultivation..."
Chu Tianxiong nodded:
"I have already entered the Purple Mansion Realm! But even with this level of cultivation, he can't compete with the Blood Moon Ancestor! "
He sighed, but suddenly smiled:
"Lu Jin, I don't encourage you to take revenge, but I want to remind you that you must be careful when you see the person with the blood moon curse mark. "
As he spoke, he opened his sleeves to reveal the crescent moon curse mark.
"Sect Master..."
Lu Jin was stunned.
"All those who bear the mark of the Blood Moon Curse are blood envoys under the Blood Moon Ancestor. "
"The so-called blood messenger is someone who seeks blood food for him, that is, a puppet who captures people to help him practice! "
"The Blood Moon Holy Land is entrenched in Qingzhou and has great power. The Blood Moon Ancestor is its strongest helmsman. In addition to the Blood Messengers, there are also Moon Messengers under him. These people are protecting the entire Qingzhou on the surface, but in fact they are maintaining the reproduction of the people. Only in this way can they provide the Blood Moon Ancestor with a steady stream of living blood food! "
“I have been patient for many years, firstly to avenge Xiaoyao Village, and secondly, to remove this cancer for the common people! "
After saying that, Chu Tianxiong smiled lightly:
“As long as you know what’s going on today. "
"In addition, Liu Ruyan colluded with Yang Dingfeng, and Yang Dingfeng's master, Elder Chiyu, has already joined the Blood Messenger Alliance, so you must proceed with caution. "
"In today's battle, you two have signed a life-and-death battle. Ji Yaoyue will definitely help Liu Ruyan break through. What are your plans? "
Lu Jin thought for a while and said:
"Three years ago, my disciples went through many dangerous places and learned about some secret realms of cultivation. I plan to go into seclusion to practice. "
Chu Tianxiong nodded and immediately put a Na Ring into Lu Jin's hands:
"The small Qingzhou cannot trap you, Lu Jin, I believe in you. "
Lu Jin lowered his head and looked at the ring in his hand, without rejecting it, he cupped his fists and said:
"Thank you, Master! "
Chu Tianxiong nodded, and then watched Lu Jin leave.
"Xuan Yunzi, you must have seen the right person..."
After Lu Jin left, he walked all the way out of the Wanjian Sect Mountain Gate.
And when he left, several figures followed behind him, secretly following him, but it was none other than Luo Jiu and several elders.
"Master Ji Peak confessed that he must be destroyed before the life and death battle! "
"Elder Luo, with our strength, we are no longer a match for Lu Jin. The top priority is to seek help from other elders! "
"Haha, don't worry, Peak Master Ji said that once you find the opportunity, immediately send out the transmission notes, and experts will come to help! "
"Follow up! "
After Lu Jin left the Wanjian Sect, in addition to Luo Jiu and others, there were other monks wearing different costumes who flew over and landed in front of Lu Jin.
"Are you? "
Lu Jin's voice was indifferent.
"Brother, to be honest, we have been waiting here for a long time! "
A man in black robes, about thirty years old, bowed his hands in a rather humble manner.
"Wait for me? "
Lu Jin frowned.
"Not bad! "
The man didn't hide anything:
"I have seen my brother's style before. I think things are not going well for me in the Ten Thousand Swords Sect. With your talent, why not join our Crazy Sword Sect instead of suffering the bird's aura in the Ten Thousand Swords Sect! "
"Haha, not bad! I, Ziyangmen, also have this intention! "
"If brother is willing, I will personally recommend you to join our inner sect of Ziyang Sect and enjoy the huge amount of cultivation resources of the sect! "
"..."
After listening to the words of several people, Lu Jin realized that they wanted to win over him.
"Thank you for your kindness. I have important things to do, so I won't accompany you. "
Lu Jin said and turned around.
"Brother, Duan Tianqiu of the Crazy Blade Sect, see you later! "
"Qin Bei of Ziyang Gate, look forward to seeing you again! "
As the two of them spoke, they actually threw two Na rings towards Lu Jin.
"No reward for no merit——"
landJin was about to decline politely, but the two of them laughed and said:
"Brothers, there is no need to be polite. It's just a matter of expressing our feelings. Multiple brothers have many paths. If we meet in the future, we will inevitably have to look after each other, don't you think?"
"It's better to provide help in times of need than to add icing on the cake. Brother, I've just taken a fancy to your potential and have no other intentions. If you're happy, just make friends. If you're not happy, just go your separate ways!"
Seeing their cheerful attitude, Lu Jin frowned slightly, then smiled faintly and uttered two words:
"Lu Jin."
After saying that, he flew out and was a hundred feet away in the blink of an eye.
"Lu Jin? This name sounds familiar."
"It's him! He was once the number one disciple of the inner sect of Wanjian Sect!"
"It is rumored that he has been missing for three years, but he is not dead?"
"Not only did he not die, he came back strong!"
